message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 79.2% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and cloud computing. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 2700 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in programming and cloud computing

explanation:
This program in Business Information Systems aligns well with your general interest in tech and is located right in Bengaluru. It has a low tuition cost ($1200) that fits your budget, requires no specific CS background, and offers a strong median starting salary of $9707.

Given your full-stack background and interest in tech, MTech Cyber Security is an excellent, high-demand specialization. It remains local to Bengaluru, has a good placement rate (80%), and its tuition ($1250) is within your budget.

MSc IT Operations provides practical skills in tech support, which can be a solid entry point if you are unsure of your exact specialization. It is local to Bengaluru, has a high median starting salary ($11419), and its tuition ($1700) is manageable within your budget.

If you are interested in the development side of things (full-stack background), MSc Software Quality Engineering focuses on software testing and engineering. While its placement rate is lower, it's a highly relevant technical field located locally.

MTech Computer Science offers broad exposure to Data Science and Software Engineering. It has the lowest tuition cost ($500) among the technical options, is local to Bengaluru, and provides a strong foundation for your career goals.
